# Vanilla Tuned

![Vanilla Tuned logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a378b9f8302ef1ba5847466d8ac37e949c96e84.png)

![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/mjuOs6lJ?style=for-the-badge)
![Modrinth Followers](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/followers/mjuOs6lJ?style=for-the-badge)

## What is Vanilla Tuned?

Vanilla Tuned is, as the name implies, a vanilla+ modpack designed to tune the base experience, without making it feel too modded or making any outlandish changes. The modpack provides optimisations as well as quality-of-life mods to enhance the game while still retaining the base survival feel.

If you want a Vanilla+ modpack with bigger changes from the base game, check out my other modpack, [Vanilla Essence](https://modrinth.com/modpack/vanillaessence)

## Reporting Issues

![GitHub Issues or Pull Requests](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/StikyPiston/VanillaTuned?style=for-the-badge)
![GitHub Discussions](https://img.shields.io/github/discussions/StikyPiston/VanillaTuned?style=for-the-badge)

Any issues with the pack can be reported [here](https://github.com/StikyPiston/VanillaTuned/issues).  
If you want to discuss the pack, show off something cool you made, or suggest a mod/feature, you can do so [here](https://github.com/StikyPiston/VanillaTuned/discussions)!
